overall_assessment: All eight courses were reviewed in full: section boundaries, learning-outcome subgroups, and most prerequisites are preserved, but semantic routing and cleanup remain incomplete in suspects and random controls. HIS4015L’s leak->teaching_methods flag is a lexical false alarm in a description of the course project; KJM5050’s leak->coursework_requirements flag is real, with further unflagged compulsory-work, misclassification, omission, administrative-text, and duplication defects. Exam language and grading scales are valid assessment design, and the PROMO courses’ attendance-based final approval is appropriately retained as assessment rather than an exam-access gate.

findings.evidence: Som ein del av praksisen i emnet er det obligatorisk å delta i minst 8 av 10 undervisningssamlingar.
findings.description: Compulsory-work details remain in teaching_methods and, in KJM5050, assessment, although coursework_requirements rows exist. NOR4515 retains its numeric seminar-attendance requirement in teaching_methods; BIOS5000 retains compulsory practice and associated teaching there; KJM5050 leaves the reflection-note submission description in teaching and assessment while moving only its approval condition. KJM5050 also leaves the 75% approval rule for arbeidskrav in assessment. These are exam-access requirements rather than graded components, so the coursework sections are incomplete and the other sections contain mislabelled text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R:.split_inline_coursework() relies on local gate sentences; .attendance_sentence_regex excludes any sentence mentioning praksis, including the NOR4515 seminar requirement. UiO has no section_inline_coursework setting, so unlabelled requirement descriptions and approval rules without an explicit exam-access clause are not collected with their gate.
findings.suggested_fix: Add UiO-specific sentence/block routing for the observed compulsory-practice and Nynorsk seminar-attendance formulations. When an explicit exam-access gate names a reflection note or arbeidskrav, collect its adjacent submission description and approval threshold into coursework_requirements; keep the final oral examination in assessment and remove the moved text from its original section.

Vurderes av faglærer ved IAKH til bestått/ikke bestått
findings.description: Under Gjennomføring av praksis, teaching_methods contains final assessment instructions: the practice teacher’s assessed sessions and assessment criteria, and the individual reflection text graded pass/fail. The Eksamen section confirms that implementation and the reflection text are the two examination components. These passages describe graded assessment, not teaching or an approval gate; assessment loses the detailed criteria and individual-work description.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading Gjennomføring av praksis maps the entire block to teaching_methods. R/extract_sections.R:.split_inline_coursework() only reroutes assessment-design lines matching .design_line_regex, which misses these practice-specific examiner and grading formulations.
findings.suggested_fix: Add bounded UiO routing within Gjennomføring av praksis: move the passages introduced by Praksislærer skal vurdere studenten, Lærer skal vurdere studenten, and the individually graded reflection-text passage into assessment, while retaining practice organization and preparatory activities in teaching_methods.

findings.evidence: Emnet inneheld 15 praksisdagar. Medan du er i praksis, får du mellom anna prøve ut ulike undervisningsopplegg og gi tilbakemeldingar på nynorske elevtekstar.
findings.description: Several Kort om emnet blocks contain separable descriptions of teaching arrangements that remain in course_content. NOR4515’s final paragraph describes practice duration and student activities; both PROMO introductions include a paragraph describing how the mentor leads the group. These belong in teaching_methods by meaning, despite the source heading. This differs from the HIS4015L flag, whose project description legitimately explains the course’s focus.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: UiO’s Kort om emnet is mapped wholesale to course_content; existing inline rerouting concentrates on gates and assessment and does not separate teaching-only paragraphs in introductions.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrowly scoped UiO paragraph-routing rules for introductions beginning Emnet inneheld followed by a number of praksisdagar and PROMO-gruppen ledes av, moving those complete teaching-arrangement paragraphs into teaching_methods without moving subject-matter descriptions.

findings.evidence: Opptak på emnet forutsetter at programmets progresjonskrav er oppfylt og at 80-gruppen i geofag er fullført.
findings.description: GEO5930L has no prerequisites row despite an explicit requirement to have completed the 80-credit subject group in geosciences. This is subject-matter prior study, not merely admission or study rights. The requirement is dropped together with the Opptak til emnet block.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps Opptak til emnet to .drop; GEO5930L has no separate prerequisite subheading to rescue the sentence before R/extract_sections.R:.clean_sections() removes dropped blocks.
findings.suggested_fix: Before removing UiO admission blocks, extract sentences explicitly requiring a completed subject group or named prior courses into prerequisites. Preserve the full mixed requirement sentence here, as permitted by course_plan_spec.md, and continue dropping programme-access-only sentences.

findings.evidence: Adgang til undervisning: Undervisningen er kun åpen for studenter med opptak i emnet.
findings.description: Teaching sections retain administrative material unrelated to teaching methods: MDID4009’s admission restriction, GEO5930L’s contact-study-administration sentence, and BIOS5000’s personal insurance advice and entitlement to repeat teaching. The sections contain useful method descriptions as well, so these are contaminated sections rather than boilerplate-only rows.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Administrative sentences embedded under Undervisning have no separate droppable heading. Admission stripping is applied to prerequisites, and the sentence-level logistics cleanup has no UiO rules for these teaching-block notices.
findings.suggested_fix: Add UiO sentence filters for the explicit Adgang til undervisning admission restriction, contact-only information sentence, insurance advice, and teaching-entitlement notice. Remove these from sections while preserving them in course_plan; retain substantive supervision, laboratory and practice descriptions.

findings.evidence: Eksamenskommisjonen består av to sensorer, hvorav minst én er ekstern. Veileder er ikke med i kommisjonen.
findings.description: Assessment retains logistics excluded by course_plan_spec.md: MDID4009 includes electronic delivery through Inspera by the deadline and the examiner arrangement; GEO5930L embeds the 3–6-week scheduling interval after submission. These are distinct from valid assessment design such as thesis length, presentation duration, exam language, permitted aids and grading scale, all of which should remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R:.section_noise and .logistics_sentences do not include UiO’s inline submission-system, examiner-composition or scheduling formulations. Heading-based .drop rules cannot remove logistics embedded in ordinary assessment paragraphs.
findings.suggested_fix: Add UiO sentence-level cleanup for delivery-system/deadline and examiner-composition sentences, plus a clause-level removal of the 3–6-week scheduling phrase. Preserve the surrounding oral-exam design and the 30-minute presentation duration.

findings.description: BIOS5000’s coursework_requirements row repeats the identical approval-gate sentence twice. The source states it under both teaching and assessment, and moving both occurrences concatenates duplicate content in one canonical section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R:.split_inline_coursework() moves the gate from both source sections, and .append_section() concatenates the results without deduplicating identical requirement units.
findings.suggested_fix: After inline routing, deduplicate exact normalized requirement sentences within coursework_requirements, preserving their first occurrence and all distinct requirement details.
